Carry children's baby teeth to space in imitation of a Japanese custom of throwing their baby teeth onto the house rooves
Description

The Mission of Wisseed Sat is to carry children's baby teeth to space in imitation of a Japanese custom of throwing their baby teeth onto the house rooves to pray for their health and growth. This mission is educationally expected to attract children to space and interest them in science and mathematics.
